prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic, but underestimated gains on winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and required early stops.
Home wait_info changes (11 tests) were helpful in three winning tests, while eight showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests), adding sign-in hints (2 tests), modifying finish layouts (2 tests), changing finish copy (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only one test or with conflicting results across tests.

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Generation Care Station: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live activity progress indicators and pet care tips while pet generation completes. (why: The home step has a long median wait time of 201s, and wait_info improvements on the home screen have historically proven to be the most effective optimization area.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Full Bleed Mascot Story Intro: Redesign the story screen into a full-bleed layout featuring an animated pet mascot welcoming new users. (why: 20.6% of users drop off at the choose_path stage; an immersive hero visual on the story screen builds immediate emotional investment.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Companion Selector: Redesign the pick_friend screen using interactive selection cards with styled companion previews. (why: Adoption suffers a 29.1% drop-off rate and high mean time (1017s); structured choice cards make companion selection clearer and faster.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] Compact Account Sign-In View: Redesign the sign-in screen into a compact layout focusing on account persistence and pet data protection. (why: Sign-in sees a 27.1% drop-off and 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after re-authenticating.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Docking Ready Notification Stream: Add a completion notification option and dynamic time estimate banner to the waiting screen. (why: With a median wait of 201s on the home waiting screen, proactive ready notifications reduce user anxiety and drop-off during generation.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync & Pet Data Protection Notice: Update sign-in copy to explicitly inform users that signing in prevents pet data reset and links pets to their profile. (why: Support received 8 tickets regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back into the application.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Centered Journey Path Cards: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a centered design with a step progress counter. (why: 20.4% of starting users drop off at choose_path; a centered layout focuses user attention on path selection.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls & Visibility Guide Copy: Provide clear onboarding finish copy explaining system tray access and desktop companion visibility controls. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop and 3 reported confusion regarding controlling or hiding the pet after setup.)
